name: AI photo
intro: Where the result really looks like you, and where it looks nothing like the ads.

apps.title: Bazaart AI Photo Editor Design
apps.verdict: A reliable creative editor with accurate background removal and AI tools. Portrait likeness is not the focus: this is a tool for design and image compositing.
apps.loved: Background removal is fast and precise, and the library of fonts and backgrounds is extensive.
apps.weak: Glitches during batch processing of more than five photos, and AI outpainting produces artifacts.
apps.whoFor: Small businesses and marketplace sellers who need to create design assets.

apps.title: Canva: AI Video & Photo Editor
apps.verdict: A versatile editor with a huge template library and basic AI. Best for casual needs, but AI tools fall short of dedicated alternatives.
apps.loved: Instantly creates presentations, posts, and logos from templates with no design skills required.
apps.weak: AI generation disappoints experienced users, and export is unreliable.
apps.whoFor: Content creators, students, and small businesses with no design background.

apps.title: Peachy - AI Face & Body Editor
apps.verdict: A capable skin and body retouching editor with a broad set of accessible tools. Used in moderation it produces natural results. Pushed hard, faces quickly look plastic.
apps.loved: Precise sliders for skin, face shape, and body contour give real control over the degree of change. Makeup looks authentic. Acne removal and skin smoothing work cleanly.
apps.weak: Heavy editing makes results look plastic and unnatural. Editing multiple people in one photo applies changes only to the first face. Some users noticed texture quality declined after a late-2024 update.
apps.whoFor: People who want to lightly retouch a real photo for social media without building a synthetic look from scratch.

apps.title: ChibiStudio Anime Avatar Maker
apps.verdict: A manual anime chibi avatar builder with no AI generation. Users assemble characters from a catalog of parts. The app is stable and free of intrusive ads.
apps.loved: Wide selection of clothes, accessories, and face types. The ability to move and scale individual elements gives flexibility in composition. The absence of intrusive banners sets it apart from competitors.
apps.weak: Many elements do not support color changes: a chosen hairstyle comes in only one shade. Few skin tone and mouth expression options. Occasionally the character disappears after closing the app.
apps.whoFor: Teens and anime fans who want a character-building tool for messages, avatars, or stickers.

apps.title: Oilist
apps.verdict: Oilist paints over a photo in oil in real time: while the app runs, the user tweaks brush, style, and color parameters and watches the painting emerge. The controls are intuitive, and the high-resolution export is suitable for printing. Recent updates have slightly slowed rendering on older devices.
apps.loved: A live painting process with instant response to parameter changes, and an infinite number of unique results from a single photo.
apps.weak: Rendering has slowed noticeably on older devices, and white patches sometimes appear on unpainted areas.
apps.whoFor: Artists and photographers who enjoy a controlled creative process rather than a one-shot filter.

apps.title: Dawn AI - Avatar generator
apps.verdict: Dawn AI trains on 10-20 user photos and generates avatar sets in various styles: historical looks, fantasy, professional headshots. Likeness to the original is consistently stronger than most competitors: several reviewers note accurate face shape, hair color, and ethnic features. Weak spots are eyes with off-center pupils and cropping that cuts the top of the head in roughly half of the shots.
apps.loved: High likeness when 15-20 varied photos are uploaded, a wide selection of historical and fantasy styles, and headshots that look professional and get used for real tasks.
apps.weak: About half the shots in a set cut off the top or bottom of the head. Eyes sometimes look unnatural with misaligned pupils or mismatched layers. Over time the style catalog stops refreshing.
apps.whoFor: People who want quality avatars with strong likeness for a profile, presentation, or just for fun trying different eras.

apps.title: Wink: Video Enhancer & Editor
apps.verdict: A specialized tool for sharpening and upscaling video for editors. The core function works convincingly. It does not alter faces or add filters.
apps.loved: Real improvement in video clarity without changing the content or adding a watermark. Noticeably improves export quality for editors working in other apps.
apps.weak: Photo enhancement sometimes shifts faces toward more Asian-looking features. The QHD function frequently throws a network error and fails to complete. The number of base-tier attempts has been cut with each update.
apps.whoFor: Video editors who want to improve final export quality without a complex pipeline.

apps.title: TokkingHeads AI Magic Avatars
apps.verdict: Animates photos to make them sing or speak along to a chosen track or voice recording. The technology is convincing. Users create touching videos from photos of deceased loved ones.
apps.loved: The ability to upload a custom video for animation sets it apart from competitors. Lip sync is convincing and the result is genuinely surprising. Ease of use is praised by nearly everyone.
apps.weak: In the free version the video is blurry. High-quality results are sent by email with a delay or do not arrive at all. The head sometimes distorts when placed on templates with sharp angles.
apps.whoFor: People who want to bring family photos to life or create fun video greetings for loved ones.

quotes.text: I like this app because it appeared to be the only AI animation app that allows you to upload a pre-recorded video for your photo to be animated to. It's just what I was looking for. I got the $3.99 weekly subscription. I'm having loads of

apps.title: ArtCard - Quick Art
apps.verdict: Converts photos into stylized painterly effects with real-time intensity adjustment. Works reliably for landscapes and still life. On elderly faces it amplifies wrinkles.
apps.loved: Real-time filter intensity adjustment gives control over the result. A wide range of styles from watercolor to oil painting. The option to send a postcard directly from the app.
apps.weak: Elderly faces come out with exaggerated wrinkles. The watermark does not disappear for some users even after a purchase. Saving sometimes freezes and the image is lost.
apps.whoFor: Art enthusiasts and photographers who want a quick painterly effect without Photoshop.

apps.title: BeautyUp－AI Face & Body Editor
apps.verdict: BeautyUp specializes in body and background editing: removes unwanted objects, protects the background during body correction, and clears skin blemishes. The background protection feature during body correction is described by real users as genuinely effective and practical. Face detection accuracy dropped after one update.
apps.loved: Background protection during body work, which users call unique. Object removal (poles, signs, entire cars) is fast and clean. Body tools allow subtle adjustments.
apps.weak: After a recent update the AI recognizes faces less accurately and produces unnatural results. Muscle correction settings were simplified from three sliders to three fixed options, reducing flexibility.
apps.whoFor: People who regularly edit photos for social media and need quick background object removal or light body correction.

apps.title: REALITY-Become an Anime Avatar
apps.verdict: A virtual streaming app with an anime avatar: upload an avatar, the camera tracks facial expressions and head movement in real time, then go live or record. Tracking works. Users who use it for VTubing describe real sessions with an audience. The main product problem is that the community mixes adults with minors, creating documented risks.
apps.loved: Facial tracking quality is good enough that the avatar looks alive during a stream. Extensive avatar appearance customization. A low barrier to entry for beginner VTubers without expensive equipment.
apps.weak: Face tracking has degraded compared to earlier versions, and the head sometimes locks into the wrong position. Full-body tracking is absent, only head and facial expressions. Several users report sudden permanent bans without warning and no appeal process.
apps.whoFor: Young people who want to try virtual streaming with an anime look without expensive equipment. Not suitable for children without adult supervision due to platform risks.

apps.title: Retake AI Face & Selfie Editor
apps.verdict: Face retouching without a full appearance replacement: removes wrinkles, evens skin, fixes squinting eyes in group photos. The result still looks like the person, not a different individual. About one in thirty attempts produces an ideal result, the rest are acceptable. Eyes sometimes look unnatural.
apps.loved: Keeps your identity intact: it is you, just at your best. Works well on group photos where someone is not looking at the camera. Natural retouching without a plastic look.
apps.weak: Eyes often look unnatural or glassy. Skin is sometimes smoothed to the point of losing texture. Results are unpredictable and there is no intensity control.
apps.whoFor: People who want to fix one specific moment in a photo without radically changing their appearance.

apps.title: MakeupPlus- AI Portrait
apps.verdict: A makeup try-on editor: apply lipstick, eyeshadow, and foundation directly onto your face or a gallery photo and save the result. The core feature works convincingly. Many users have used the app for years to compare lipstick or eyeshadow shades before buying. The problem is automatic, irreversible enhancements that alter the face without being asked.
apps.loved: Makeup overlay looks natural and not overdone on most photos. A large choice of colors and styles. Long-term users since 2016 note stable core quality up until recent updates.
apps.weak: The app automatically whitens teeth and smooths skin with no way to turn it off, making people look unrecognizable, especially those who already have light teeth or freckles. Some features work poorly with glasses or deeper skin tones. After recent updates some filters stopped loading.
apps.whoFor: People who want to try on makeup before buying or before going out. Also suitable for those who want to see themselves with a different hair color or eye style in a photo.

apps.title: Headshot Pro AI: Perfect Photo
apps.verdict: Generates professional-looking portraits from a few photos. When it lands, the result looks like a genuine professional shot. Unpredictable: some users get accurate likenesses, others get a stranger in the right suit.
apps.loved: When it works, the result looks like a real professional shot with correct facial features and lighting. One user wrote it was the first AI-generated photo that actually looked like them.
apps.weak: Appearance is unpredictable: different hair color, different body type, and dark-skinned users see blotches and skin lightening. Several users received images in underwear instead of business attire. The result cannot be previewed before receiving it.
apps.whoFor: People who need a quick business portrait for LinkedIn and are comfortable with unpredictable quality.

apps.title: New Profile Pic Maker - ToonMe
apps.verdict: A cartoon avatar builder, not a realistic photo generator. In its own genre it works: one user wrote the character looks exactly like them. It limits the number of characters and the clothing selection is sparse.
apps.loved: The cartoon character is recognizable and resembles the face in the photo when the source image is good. Friendly interface, animated stickers with expressive facial gestures.
apps.weak: Limited clothing selection, especially for male characters. The avatar cannot be used directly in messengers. The beard and some clothing items produce layering artifacts.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers and parents who want a safe cartoon avatar for messengers and profiles.

apps.title: Picsart AI Photo Editor, Video
apps.verdict: Once a strong editor, it has degraded: AI avatars now look puppet-like, tools poorly understand tasks, and the interface is cluttered with intrusive AI features.
apps.loved: A rich collection of backgrounds and stickers, and portrait retouching for experienced users.
apps.weak: Avatars are disproportionate and do not resemble you, and the output is hard to predict.
apps.whoFor: Collage and sticker users who do not expect accurate portrait AI.

apps.title: New Profile Pic Avatar Maker
apps.verdict: Converts photos into artistic portraits and cartoon looks. With a good source image the result is impressive: a variety of styles and regular updates. The weak spot is that male photos with long hair are read as female, and group photos are not supported. Works best with sharp single-person portraits.
apps.loved: A wide choice of artistic styles, with new themes added regularly. Good detail when the source photo is high quality. Successful results preserve facial recognizability.
apps.weak: A male face with long hair gets feminized. Group photos do not work. Over time styles begin to repeat and variety drops.
apps.whoFor: Fans of art avatars and social profiles who want an artistic look rather than a realistic photo.

quotes.text: If you have a clear, high-quality photo of just one person, you'll find it easy to get a fantastic drawn portrait! However, using the app to take a picture of a photo can be quite tricky. Following the steps is straightforward, but challeng

apps.title: Hyper: VTuber Studio
apps.verdict: A mobile VTubing app with face tracking and avatar customization. The facial tracking technology works and is impressive. Live streaming was removed, turning a social platform into a solo tool.
apps.loved: Facial tracking is smooth and responsive. The AI companion receives positive reviews for creative dialogue. A one-time payment for pro access with no recurring fees is noted as a fair model.
apps.weak: After switching to a no-livestream mode, the live audience interaction that motivated many users is gone. Hand tracking is unstable. The app randomly signs users out during a session.
apps.whoFor: People who want to try mobile VTubing without investing in equipment. Works for recording short videos with an avatar, but not for those seeking a live audience.

apps.title: SNOW - AI Profile
apps.verdict: A real-time AR filter and beauty effects camera. Filters run smoothly and cleanly. It visibly lightens dark skin tones, and a number of features have gradually moved behind a PRO paywall.
apps.loved: AR filters run smoothly and look clean even with movement. A wide selection of beauty masks and effects. Lets you record video with filters without lag.
apps.weak: Visibly lightens and desaturates dark skin tones. Photo resolution is reduced without PRO access. The app has become noticeably laggy since AI features were added.
apps.whoFor: Users who want a camera with live AR masks and beauty filters for shooting video and selfies in real time.

apps.title: Photo Editоr
apps.verdict: A collage editor with text, stickers, and basic retouching. Collage and overlay tools work. The face retouching feature is unstable and produces unpredictable results when reshaping facial structure.
apps.loved: A convenient collage tool with a large selection of layouts and fonts. Photo overlays and cutouts are used in a business context. Stickers and text work reliably.
apps.weak: The skin smoothing feature leaves scratches and artifacts. Reshaping facial structure gives unpredictable results. There is no meaningful AI processing: the app is primarily a collage editor.
apps.whoFor: People creating collages and designing posts for personal or business use, with no need for AI generation.

apps.title: Perfect Me: AI Portrait Editor
apps.verdict: A portrait editor with manual sliders for facial features, hair, and makeup correction. Manual control over the degree of change sets it apart from generators. The app sometimes freezes on launch after updates.
apps.loved: Manual sliders for individual features give real control over the result. The object removal tool works well. The basic features are enough for everyday editing without extra fees.
apps.weak: The app freezes on launch and requires several attempts before it opens. The background replacement tool only works for one face when multiple people are in the photo. Video features are unstable.
apps.whoFor: People who want to subtly correct a real photo without creating a synthetic avatar.

apps.title: BeautyPlus-Selfie Photo Editor
apps.verdict: A light portrait editor with skin retouching and hair color changing. New filters add noise, and smoothing without control gives a plastic look.
apps.loved: Skin retouching and hair color changes work quickly right during capture.
apps.weak: Smoothing is set to maximum on its own, and the face detector misses faces in groups.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who wants light selfie retouching for social media without deep editing.

apps.title: FaceLab: Face Age, Hair Filter
apps.verdict: Specializes in hairstyle and hair color try-on. When it fits the face shape, the result is convincing: features are preserved and skin is not distorted. But it works unreliably on dark skin and non-standard hair textures. The AI-updated version received criticism for quality regression compared to the previous approach.
apps.loved: Hair color changes in realistic tones look natural. Results with common haircuts on a clean face photo read convincingly.
apps.weak: Struggles with curly and afro textures. Dark skin produces unpredictable results. Long-term users consider the new AI interface worse than the previous neutral filters.
apps.whoFor: People who want to try a new color or cut before visiting a salon, with straight European hair types.

apps.title: Glam AI: Video & Photo Editor
apps.verdict: Glam AI generates photos and short videos with a glossy beauty effect. When it works, the results are genuinely polished and look like professional photography. The problem is that several independent reviewers document a sharp quality drop after a model update: faces became unrecognizable and extra limbs and artifacts appeared. The app is clearly aimed at women: men get their hair changed to feminine styles and have inappropriate looks applied.
apps.loved: At its best, glossy quality resembling editorial photography, the 15-photo upload option for better likeness, and a simple intuitive interface.
apps.weak: After model updates, faces often bear no resemblance to the original. Extra hands and body distortions appear. Little content for men and styles are built around a female audience.
apps.whoFor: Women creating social media content who want glossy looks without a photo shoot, assuming the model quality does not degrade again.

apps.title: AI Leap: AI Headshot Generator
apps.verdict: A renamed LightX editor with an added AI headshot generator. The cutout tool is more precise than competitors. Headshots frequently fail to capture likeness.
apps.loved: The object-from-background cutout tool is one of the best on mobile. Layer blending and background replacement work cleanly. The image outpainting tool works convincingly.
apps.weak: AI headshots often miss the likeness: facial features, type, and expression all shift. A daily attempt limit sharply restricts usage. Long-time LightX users lost previously available editor features when the app was renamed.
apps.whoFor: Users who need a mobile editor with precise cutouts and blending. Less suitable for those seeking a realistic AI portrait with their own face.

apps.title: MyMood AI: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: An AI image generator with personal model training on uploaded photos. When the model is trained well, likeness is convincing and above average for the category. The style variety is large. The main flaw is instability: limbs duplicate, finger counts are wrong, and bodies are sometimes out of proportion. Retraining the model improves likeness.
apps.loved: With proper model training the face comes out recognizable and polished. Large style selection. Dark skin tones are rendered better than on competing apps.
apps.weak: Three arms, six fingers, disproportionate bodies: artifacts appear frequently. Generated bodies can look unrealistic in shape.
apps.whoFor: Users willing to invest time in training a model in exchange for polished high-quality looks for social media.

apps.title: FakeMe: Face Swap AI Photo App
apps.verdict: A face swap app for video and photos. Single-face swap quality is praised as one of the best among alternatives. After an update, results degraded to nightmarish distortions according to several users.
apps.loved: Single-face video swap quality at good lighting and a straight angle is described as the best among mobile alternatives. Recognition accuracy is high with clear source material.
apps.weak: After an update results became disturbing: faces distort beyond recognition. Multi-face swaps work unpredictably: faces get mixed up or incorrectly overlaid. Video processing is capped at one minute.
apps.whoFor: People looking for a tool to swap one face in a short video clip for entertainment or creative projects.

quotes.text: Ever since they updated the AI, the deepfake results I've been getting are absolute nightmare fuel. It warps and distorts the faces so badly to the point where it looks like stuff straight out of a creepypasta. I think the AI is a little bi

apps.title: Visify: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A themed headshot and look generator with fast processing. In some cases the result looks professional. In a third of cases the face does not resemble the original, and the store page promises features that are not in the app.
apps.loved: Fast generation with no long wait. Some headshots look professional and realistic. A wide variety of themed styles and backgrounds.
apps.weak: In a third of cases the face in the result does not resemble the person from the photo. The store page promises features like group photos that do not exist in the app. A large watermark remains on images.
apps.whoFor: People who want to experiment with themed photo looks and will not be bothered if a few shots miss the likeness.

apps.title: HeyGen: AI Video Generator
apps.verdict: A professional tool for creating videos with avatars and lip sync. The core technology works: the avatar speaks with believable facial expression and the interface is approachable enough. Weak spots are inconsistent quality after updates, avatars that became less natural compared to earlier versions, and hard generation limits at every pricing tier.
apps.loved: Lip sync with voice is convincing. Several experienced business users report real time savings on content production. The interface is intuitive for beginners and allows a fast start with no technical knowledge.
apps.weak: After an update, avatar movements became more robotic and less cinematic than before. Generation limits hit unexpectedly quickly: a few videos in and the counter resets. The mobile version is significantly stripped down compared to the web version.
apps.whoFor: Business video creators, marketers, and small teams who need to produce presentations without live filming. Not for those seeking photorealistic results with their own face.

apps.title: Remini - AI Photo Enhancer
apps.verdict: Sharpening old photos works when it works. But newer updates make faces look cartoonish and unrecognizable.
apps.loved: Sharpness and detail in old photos genuinely improve, and processing is fast.
apps.weak: The new algorithm changes facial features beyond recognition and produces a plastic look.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs to restore old family photos. Results are inconsistent.

quotes.text: I paid for a week of Remini AI photos expecting stylized versions of MYSELF, not random AI women wearing toddler roller skates, sitting in strawberry fields, hiding in teddy bears, or looking like Celine Dion's emotionally unavailable cousi

apps.title: AI Photo Editor: Filter & Edit
apps.verdict: An editor with AI photo enhancement: sharpening, color correction, background removal, and basic retouching. Sharpening old and dark photos produces a noticeable result. Portrait retouching preserves skin texture better than most competitors. On-demand look generation is unstable: it sometimes outputs a stranger or a completely different look.
apps.loved: Enhancing dark and blurry photos produces visible results without excessive smoothing. Portrait retouching preserves natural skin texture.
apps.weak: AI look generation is unstable: the result may bear no resemblance to the user. High load slows processing of high-quality images.
apps.whoFor: People who want to improve old or poorly shot photos, not those trying to create AI portraits.

apps.title: ZEPETO: Avatar, Connect & Live
apps.verdict: A social platform with cartoon 3D avatars. Not a realistic photo tool. Portrait likeness is not part of the design goal.
apps.loved: Expressive 3D avatars with rich customization, the ability to stream, and to post videos.
apps.weak: Does not look like you: the cartoon stylization is far from a real portrait.
apps.whoFor: Teens who need a virtual identity for social interaction, not a realistic photo.

apps.title: Photo Lab — AI Image Editor
apps.verdict: A huge filter and effects library with fast processing, good for creative collages and holiday cards. However results often do not resemble the original face. The AI reshapes appearance to fit its own template. After updates, tag search was removed, the content filter was tightened, and the generation limit for subscribers was cut, frustrating longtime users.
apps.loved: Enormous variety of effects and styles, fast processing, and the ability to make holiday cards with multiple people in a photo.
apps.weak: The face in the result often does not look like you. The AI pushes toward an averaged template. With darker skin the result sometimes changes ethnicity. Background and hand detail quality is low.
apps.whoFor: People who want to quickly make a creative collage or themed card without needing accurate portrait likeness.

apps.title: Fotor AI Photo Editor & Video
apps.verdict: Fotor is a broad photo editor with restoration, black-and-white colorization, object removal, and text-to-image. For restoring old photos it works well. AI portraits (LinkedIn headshots) are weak: several independent reviews describe results as 'chubby alien heads' or 'cartoons', and none resemble a real person. Skin retouching is excessive and faces look plastic.
apps.loved: Restoring and colorizing archival photos works convincingly. Removing unwanted background objects is effective. A wide set of collage tools and basic color correction.
apps.weak: AI portraits do not capture appearance: faces come out generic and far from the original. Skin retouching is too aggressive and naturalness is lost. Text-to-image generation frequently ignores prompt details.
apps.whoFor: People who want to restore old family photos or make a collage, but not for creating professional portraits.

apps.title: Camera+: Pro Camera & Editor
apps.verdict: A camera app with manual ISO, shutter speed, and exposure control. Clarity mode is impressive on landscapes. After a change of ownership, the app stopped opening without an internet connection, which is critical for shooting outdoors.
apps.loved: Clarity mode delivers an impressive result on landscape shots with a single tap. Manual control over every shooting parameter in one interface without switching screens. Long-term users describe years of productive use.
apps.weak: The app does not open without an internet connection, making it useless when shooting in nature or while traveling. Several users report being unable to save photos to the gallery after updates. The editing extension from the native Photos app stopped working.
apps.whoFor: Mobile photographers who need manual shooting controls and RAW support on iPhone. Not suitable for those who shoot without a stable internet connection.

apps.title: Shots: AI Photo Video Creator
apps.verdict: A light generator of short videos and photos themed around world events (World Cup, Toy Story, Michael Jackson). The result is more 'themed character with some of the user's features' than an exact copy. On simple templates likeness is acceptable, and on complex poses and group photos the face noticeably drifts. Speed is good. Content is updated to match current events.
apps.loved: Simple templates produce a recognizable face and realistic animation without limb doubling. The result arrives quickly and genuinely makes people laugh.
apps.weak: Likeness is unstable: faces shift on complex poses. In pair videos one of the people may look completely different. A child's gender is sometimes misidentified.
apps.whoFor: People who want to share a fun themed video on social media without expecting photo-accurate likeness.

quotes.text: I'm so happy I made one of my parents with my five-year-old nephew and it had both my parents hysterical and it's so nice to have them laughing. My dad's 83 and my mom is 81 so to show a video like this it's hilarious and it made their day

apps.title: Photoroom: AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: Precise background removal was a strong point, but AI models do not produce likeness to real people. Updates break what was working.
apps.loved: Accurate background removal for product photos, and batch processing saves time.
apps.weak: Virtual models do not resemble real people and are unsuitable for commercial use.
apps.whoFor: Marketplace sellers who need background removal, not portrait AI.

apps.title: EPIK - AI Photo & Video Editor
apps.verdict: An editor with a set of effects and annual yearbook-style photo generation. When it works, it delivers interesting artistic transformations. The problem is that yearbook photo results frequently do not resemble the person, especially for users with dark skin or curly hair. White skin tone is imposed regardless of the person's ethnicity.
apps.loved: Cartoon and artistic filters work convincingly. The photo enhancement feature genuinely restores detail in blurry images.
apps.weak: Annual yearbook-style photos often output a different person. Curly hair is replaced with straight. Dark-skinned users have their skin lightened without reason.
apps.whoFor: A younger audience that wants quick artistic transformations and filters, not realistic portraits.

apps.title: LightX: AI Generator & Editor
apps.verdict: An editor with object cutout, layer overlay, and background replacement tools. Core features work decently. Avatar generation is weak: results do not capture appearance and repeat the same poses.
apps.loved: The object cutout tool is accurate and faster than competitors. A large font selection for design. Some AI backgrounds are generated convincingly.
apps.weak: Avatars poorly represent the user's appearance and repeat the same poses. AI text-to-image generation ignores prompt details. The app crashes mid-edit.
apps.whoFor: People making simple graphic collages who need cutout and overlay tools, not realistic portrait generation.

apps.title: Spellai - AI Art Maker
apps.verdict: A text-to-image generator with anime and realistic styles. Male prompts consistently produce female results. Content filters block neutral words like 'beautiful' or 'pose'.
apps.loved: A variety of styles and character customization. Daily free attempts without spending money. An active community.
apps.weak: Male prompts almost always produce female images. The content filter blocks innocent words in prompts. Generation quality has noticeably declined with recent updates.
apps.whoFor: Anime fans and character creators for role-playing games who are comfortable with strict content moderation.

quotes.text: At first, this seemed to be the most accurate AI creator I'd seen. But over the last month, I've noticed a decline in the quality. The ai clips are becoming too cartoonish, they're starting to do that weird thing where a person's arms and o

apps.title: Avatarify: AI Face Animator
apps.verdict: Animates photos to music: the face sings or speaks along to a familiar tune. Works for memes and quick jokes. The animation is crude, covering only the mouth with no eye or head movement, and the result looks like a cheap edit.
apps.loved: Quickly and amusingly animates any photo to a familiar tune. The result immediately gets laughs from viewers. Photos stay on the device and are not uploaded to servers.
apps.weak: Animation is limited to the mouth only: eyebrows, gaze, and head movements do not change. On some photos the face blurs and distorts. The result easily looks like a cheap edit under close inspection.
apps.whoFor: People who make memes and want to make an old photo 'sing' for a laugh in chats.

apps.title: starryai - AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A text-to-image generator with a rich selection of artistic styles. Prompt execution is unreliable: elements disappear or unwanted ones appear. The enhancement feature lightens dark-skinned characters.
apps.loved: A rich selection of artistic styles with the option to create custom ones. An active community with contests. Daily free attempts allow trying the app without spending money.
apps.weak: The enhancement feature consistently lightens dark-skinned characters to white. Prompts are executed unreliably: specified elements disappear and unwanted ones appear. The content filter triggers on neutral words.
apps.whoFor: People creating stylized illustrations and concept art who are willing to spend time dialing in prompts.

apps.title: AI Maker: Photo Video Filters
apps.verdict: An entertainment video builder with filters. Non-resemblance to the original is expected: the app does not position itself as an accurate portrait tool. The result is more 'similar character' than 'yourself'. Templates update weekly, generation takes up to 20 minutes. Quality depends on the template: simple dance clips are acceptable, complex scenes produce limb doubling and a blurry face.
apps.loved: Filters with simple movements and holiday scenes transfer facial features recognizably. The result draws laughs and joy, and is good enough for home viewing.
apps.weak: Faces often distort on complex poses. The image looks obviously generated. With a bad source photo the result looks aged, acne-ridden, or unrecognizable.
apps.whoFor: People who want a funny clip for family or social media without expecting accurate likeness.

apps.title: InstaSize: AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: A simple cropping tool that has degraded: a mandatory AI outpainting step now runs on every photo and produces artifacts, and video export quality is low.
apps.loved: Fast cropping for social media with the correct aspect ratios preserved.
apps.weak: The AI outpainter runs automatically and adds artifacts, with minimal user control.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who just needs to resize a photo for Instagram rather than portrait AI.

apps.title: Voilà AI Artist Cartoon Filter
apps.verdict: One of the strongest in the category for artistic cartoon stylization quality: a Renaissance portrait, anime, or Disney look comes out detailed and atmospheric. But the app works with only one face per photo, regularly shifts dark skin to lighter tones, and the servers are periodically unavailable. The style library shrank after updates.
apps.loved: Artistic stylization quality, especially for anime and Renaissance portraits, is above average. Processing takes seconds when the servers are up.
apps.weak: Only one face per photo. Regularly changes skin color and eye color to lighter shades for people with a dark complexion. The server is unavailable for hours during peak times. Some popular styles were removed in recent updates.
apps.whoFor: People who want a one-off artistic avatar in a specific style, such as anime, Renaissance, or a Disney character, for a profile or as a gift.

quotes.text: First of all, this is an amazingly fun app. However, it is a bit "wonky". For example, it does have difficulty distinguishing eye color and it appears the "default" eye color is blue or green. Tried numerous photos of brown eyed individuals

apps.title: AI Mirror: AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: An artistic style and anime look generator. With narrow styles like 'anime' or 'Egyptian pharaoh' it produces visually appealing results. However realistic portraits are not the app's goal: photos are processed aggressively, ethnicity and skin tone shift. Dark-skinned users are lightened without reason.
apps.loved: A wide catalog of artistic themes: anime, fantasy, historical looks. The old photo restoration feature works for family archives.
apps.weak: Realism is sacrificed for stylization. Dark-skinned users are turned light-skinned. Artistic filters heavily alter appearance and no recognizable likeness remains.
apps.whoFor: Fans of artistic stylization and anime looks who care about style rather than portrait accuracy.

apps.title: Lensa AI: Photo Editor
apps.verdict: Once a leader in magical avatars, it now renders inaccurately: wrong skin color, mouth always open, plastic look. The best styles were removed in updates.
apps.loved: Previously generated 200 portraits with recognizable likeness and a variety of styles.
apps.weak: The new model does not preserve skin color, the mouth is always open, and style choices are limited.
apps.whoFor: Nobody in particular right now: the app has lost its niche between realism and art avatars.

quotes.text: I've always loved this app and have spent quite a bit on magic avatars in the past because they're so beautiful, organic, and accurate. However, I'm leaving a 2-star review because I can no longer seem to access the original magic avatar st

apps.title: Photoleap: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: When it works, it generates detailed and stylistically rich images that outperform competitors on artistic quality. But the app has been systematically degrading: over three years background blur, layers, social media integrations, headshot transformation, and other key features have been removed. The content filter blocks even moderate content like swimwear and bare shoulders. AI generation frequently returns 'something went wrong'.
apps.loved: When a generation succeeds, artistic quality is above average for the market. The enhance tool genuinely sharpens old photos. Supports a range of styles from realism to surrealism.
apps.weak: Does not follow precise prompt instructions, especially for hand details and backgrounds. A strict content filter blocks neutral requests. The interface has deteriorated significantly through a series of updates.
apps.whoFor: Designers and illustrators who need an unconventional stylized image rather than an accurate portrait of themselves.

apps.title: Customuse: AI 3D Creator
apps.verdict: A Roblox clothing creator with freehand drawing and text tools. Core functionality works. Not a photo or avatar realism app: the niche is narrowly specialized.
apps.loved: Drawing and text tools work for creating simple clothing items for game avatars. Many fonts are available in the free tier.
apps.weak: Almost every template is locked behind PRO access. After an update, AI fully replaced manual creation and some users can no longer make clothing themselves. Publishing to Roblox is unstable.
apps.whoFor: Young Roblox players willing to pay for a subscription to create their own avatar clothing.

apps.title: Reface: Face Edit AI Photo App
apps.verdict: Face swap with a specific person works recognizably, but headshots look nothing like the person who uploaded them. Style and hairstyle choices are limited, and the NSFW filter blocks neutral portraits.
apps.loved: When face swap works, the face in the result is recognizable and close to the original. The algorithm consistently preserves features in good lighting.
apps.weak: Headshots almost never resemble the real person. The NSFW filter triggers on neutral and classical photos. Hairstyle choices are limited to one or two options in the base mode.
apps.whoFor: Hard to define: for most users the product does not do what it claims.

apps.title: ToonMe: AI Cartoon Face Maker
apps.verdict: Stylizes photos into a cartoon Disney format fairly quickly. The algorithm consistently lightens dark-skinned people and changes skin color, which users directly call discriminatory. More than half of the features are PRO-only.
apps.loved: Cartoon stylization works quickly and produces a recognizable character when the source photo has a clear face in good lighting. The Disney filter delivers quality results with proper exposure.
apps.weak: The algorithm consistently makes dark-skinned people lighter and changes hair texture to afro regardless of the original. Refuses to process bald heads, hats, or partially obscured faces. Facial expression and details (eyes, nose) are often lost in simplification.
apps.whoFor: People who want a one-time fun avatar in a cartoon style for a messenger, with no expectation of portrait accuracy.

quotes.text: The cartooning is quite good, but for some reason it only works if the picture has a very distinctive face. More than half the time, it doesn't work because it cannot find a face, even when there is a clear face in the picture. It would be

apps.title: Persona: AI Beauty Editor
apps.verdict: Persona is a beauty camera and photo editor for skin smoothing, makeup, and real-time retouching. The filters do deliver a glossy magazine effect, but at the cost of individual features: skin looks plastic and eyelash artifacts flash on every frame. The app strongly lightens dark skin, which several reviewers flag directly as a problem. Output resolution is lower than the source.
apps.loved: Lets you quickly look 'retouched' in video and photos for social media. An intensity slider gives control over the degree of processing. Works in real time on video.
apps.weak: Lightens dark skin and smooths facial features beyond recognition. Eyelash artifacts are visible on every filter without close inspection. Reduces the resolution of the final image.
apps.whoFor: Social media content creators who need a quick beauty filter on video without aiming for realism.

apps.title: Faceplay: AI Video Photo Maker
apps.verdict: Faceplay positions itself as a face swap and AI avatar app, but output quality is poor: faces frequently do not align, images warp, and support for dark skin tones is nearly absent. Several reviewers noted quality degradation after updates.
apps.loved: Some users rate face alignment accuracy highly in the basic mode and enjoy the variety of templates: one reviewer wrote that in 30 seconds the face matched perfectly. The gender swap mode is seen as an entertaining feature.
apps.weak: Results for dark skin are catastrophic: the app either lightens the face beyond recognition or refuses to process the photo at all. Faces blur and distort on overlay, glasses disappear, and images do not align when using multiple photos.
apps.whoFor: Light-skinned users who want a quick themed look for entertainment.

quotes.text: First can I say this is honestly not a bad app. And I would've given it a higher scoring if they were more diversity for people of color. Seriously there are hardly any people of color in this app which means people at me can't use it unles

apps.title: AI Video Photo・DreamPix Editor
apps.verdict: An editor with a wide range of artistic styles and filters. When the servers are up and a style is chosen well, results impress with variety. However likeness to the original person is the weak point: faces come out generic, skin tone often lightens beyond recognition, and biometric features are lost.
apps.loved: A large variety of artistic modes including animation and background replacement. Several users praise the interface simplicity and speed on good days.
apps.weak: The result rarely resembles a specific person. Skin becomes too light and facial features are generalized. One reviewer: 'Endless style choices, but every time the output is a stranger'. Racial skin shift is mentioned by several users who are not white.
apps.whoFor: People looking for artistic photo stylization for the effect, not for a recognizable portrait.

apps.title: Retouch - AI Face Editor
apps.verdict: A skin and face retouching editor with a simple interface. Basic skin smoothing works for straightforward portraits. Body reshaping tools produce visible distortions.
apps.loved: A simple interface and basic skin smoothing work for uncomplicated portraits and light retouching.
apps.weak: Body shape tools produce visible outline distortions. Some effects do not apply when tapped. The app crashes when opening photos from recent iOS versions.
apps.whoFor: For light skin retouching on simple portraits, if you can sort out the payment flow.

apps.title: Meitu AI Photo & Video Editor
apps.verdict: A rich photo and video editor with film simulations, anime portraits, and real-time skin correction. Filters look natural with moderate use. The algorithm automatically removes moles without permission.
apps.loved: Film simulations produce a convincing analog look. Real-time skin correction on video looks natural. The video quality enhancement tool noticeably outperforms most competitors.
apps.weak: The algorithm automatically removes moles and marks with no way to keep them. Glow Up sometimes makes faces comically smooth. Daily limits appear without warning even for VIP users.
apps.whoFor: Bloggers and short video creators who need fast video retouching while preserving a natural look, not a radical transformation.

apps.title: PhotoApp - AI Photo Enhancer
apps.verdict: The core feature, sharpening old and blurry photos, works impressively in the best cases: users printed results as gifts. But the app is unstable: it frequently goes into 'maintenance mode' at unexpected moments and results vary widely from photo to photo. Black-and-white colorization and an aging filter are available, but face accuracy is low.
apps.loved: In the best cases, improving the resolution of old family photos yields a result good enough to print. Colorizing black-and-white images works convincingly for neutral landscapes.
apps.weak: Results depend on the photo, and faces often look like strangers. Frequent server outages interrupt work. The aging filter and 'baby filter' produce characters that bear no resemblance to the original.
apps.whoFor: People with a specific old blurry photo they want to improve for printing, who are willing to try several times to get a usable result.

quotes.text: This app is great!! I wanted to print photos for a gift for my dad's 70th birthday. So I needed GREAT photos. I print photos using an app for a local store, and almost every photo gave me a "low resolution" error. So I Googled how to fix th

apps.title: YouCam Perfect:AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: An editor with real-time makeup application via the camera. Skin correction at moderate settings looks natural. AI automatically removes moles and smooths features to a plastic look.
apps.loved: Applying makeup over a photo through a live camera works convincingly. A wide set of tools for skin tone and highlight. Correction results at moderate settings look natural.
apps.weak: AI removes moles and marks without user permission and with no way to preserve them. Face correction quickly becomes unnaturally smooth. Collage tools run slowly even on powerful devices.
apps.whoFor: Users who want quick cosmetic retouching for beauty content, if they are willing to monitor subscription terms carefully.

This is the best makeup editor I've used — a rare blend of technical mastery and editorial taste that turns raw footage into magazine-ready moments with unapologetic confidence.

What it does brilliantly

• Makeup transformations: realistic

apps.title: Restyle: AI Headshot Generator
apps.verdict: A rich library of artistic filters for photos and videos with fast rendering. Two systematic flaws: the result consistently lightens people of any non-white appearance, and the watermark cannot be removed.
apps.loved: A rich library of artistic styles, fast rendering. Some results look stylish. Repeat generation is available with one tap.
apps.weak: People with dark skin, Asian, and Filipino features consistently come out white in results. The watermark remains on exports. Video rendering takes up to 20 minutes for a 10-second clip.
apps.whoFor: Experimenters with artistic filters who are comfortable with approximate likeness and have no need for clean exports.

quotes.text:
Looks nothing like the ads, takes 20min a video to render and never looks as advertised in the template previews (extremely pixelated and bad quality ai graphics, don't actually look like what's in the videos I uploaded). 
Granted, I only w

apps.title: Pose: AI Photo Video Generator
apps.verdict: Overlays a face on video of a dance or a template pose. In successful cases the result is convincing. The face often changes beyond recognition, and the AI once removed clothing from a child when generating a mermaid look.
apps.loved: In rare successful generations the face looks convincing on a dance video. Processing speed is acceptable.
apps.weak: The face in the result often does not resemble the uploaded photo. Several users describe the output as a completely different person. The AI removed clothing from a child when generating a mermaid look from a photo with a covered torso.
apps.whoFor: An extremely narrow audience: people who specifically want an entertainment video effect with a dancing avatar and can tolerate low accuracy.

apps.title: Momo: AI Photo & Video Maker
apps.verdict: Likeness to the original is unstable: half of users get a recognizable face, the other half get a different person of a different race or gender. Hair color is reproduced poorly and body proportions are often distorted. There is variety in templates, but output quality swings unpredictably from shot to shot.
apps.loved: Sometimes produces realistic LinkedIn portraits. Good variety of styles and themes. Hands without obvious anomalies, which is rare in this category.
apps.weak: Regularly changes the user's race, gender, or hair color. Neck and head proportions distort. Results are unpredictable: one good attempt is followed by three bad ones.
apps.whoFor: People who want a casual fun portrait and are comfortable with lottery-style results.

quotes.text: Okay first impression was cool. Good variety and lots of options. The hands weren't obviously AI and fake. The body sizes were similar structure. The next attempt and profile I created, I ended up three different races. I was laughing and t

I purchased a subscription and was able to credit 2 "packs", which honestly I wasn't all too impressed with, but it served its purpose. I was using this to create a headshot for an email profile picture. I selected another pack, paid the co

I was impressed by the facial accuracy in over half the photos. However, it only got my hair color correct in five. My hair is strawberry blonde- which means it has a lot of different shades, and it just made my hair brown in everything. Be

apps.title: Loopsie: AI Image Effects
apps.verdict: Loopsie creates animated photos with motion effects and AI video. Historically the app was praised for live photos with controlled movement direction, but functionality has been cut. The main complaint now is that videos process for anywhere from several hours to a full day and output a random face instead of the user, and sometimes just a black screen. The promised AI generates ready-made presets rather than real photo processing.
apps.loved: The 'live photo' concept with controlled movement was strong, and results for simple nature or object animations sometimes come out atmospheric.
apps.weak: Video generation takes 10-24 hours and frequently outputs a stranger's face or a black screen. Men are turned into women in the output. Results are described as 'amateur' even in successful generations.

apps.title: PhotoDirector: AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: A multifunctional editor with a rich tool set, but real AI generation quality falls short of what is promised. Avatars do not resemble the user: facial features are averaged, generated characters look like dolls from another dimension. Object removal and retouching work acceptably on simple photos. Portrait filters add plastic skin and erase individuality.
apps.loved: Retouching and object cutout tools are accurate enough for everyday tasks. A wide feature set in one place.
apps.weak: AI avatars do not resemble the original. Portrait effects produce a plastic, puppet-like look. Anime and cartoon styles distort facial features and lighten dark-skinned users.
apps.whoFor: People looking for an editor with basic retouching and cropping, not accurate AI portraits.

apps.title: ImagineArt: AI Video Generator
apps.verdict: A text-prompt image generator with several artistic styles. Early versions received sincere praise for render quality, but a series of updates progressively removed the best models, introduced strict generation limits, and broke the generative fill feature on iOS. Current state: some styles are unavailable and the app freezes on loading.
apps.loved: At its best, detailed images that users compared to Midjourney. Several artists praise it as a tool for quick concept visualization.
apps.weak: The generator ignores specific instructions about poses, clothing, and scene composition. Results almost always show faces even when a landscape is requested. Generative fill quality has degraded to a cartoon level according to several independent reviews.
apps.whoFor: Artists who need quick rough sketches, using the web version rather than the mobile app.

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: ARTA
apps.verdict: Positioned as a realistic avatar generator, but the output regularly does not resemble the person in the photo. Prompts are partially executed or ignored. Every update removes features that users paid for.
apps.loved: In lucky cases it generates convincing realistic looks for product photos. A wide range of artistic styles, some of which produce interesting results.
apps.weak: The output regularly does not resemble the person in the photo. Prompts are ignored: the app does what it wants. Every update removes styles and features (Schnell, SDXL, graphic novel, AI influence control) that users paid for.
apps.whoFor: Authors and illustrators who need generalized artistic character looks, not an accurate portrait of themselves.

quotes.text: I don't normally leave reviews, but AI Arta pushed me over the edge. This app was marketed as a "realistic image generator" and photo enhancer—with promises of professional-looking AI filters and headshots. What I got was a complete joke.

apps.title: Instories: AI Photo & Video
apps.verdict: A platform for creating stories and reels with ready-made templates. Best results come from experienced users with prepared content. AI image generation produces anatomical artifacts and ignores prompts.
apps.loved: Ready-made story templates speed up production of standard content. For experienced users the interface is flexible enough to produce acceptable results.
apps.weak: AI generation produces anatomical errors: extra arms and distorted faces. Prompts are only partially followed or ignored entirely. The gap between what is shown in the app store and the actual product is critically large.
apps.whoFor: SMM specialists who need a fast flow of templated story content, with no expectations from AI quality.

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: ImgAI
apps.verdict: Positioned as an AI image generator, but a significant portion of the audience uses it as a wallpaper catalog. Generation contains anatomical errors and does not follow prompts.
apps.loved: Some users are happy with the collection of high-resolution wallpapers for iPhone. The selection of background images is diverse.
apps.weak: The AI generator ignores or misinterprets prompts. Results featuring people contain distorted facial features. The attempt limit is too small to assess quality before the first payment.
apps.whoFor: Anyone looking for phone wallpapers, if this is treated as a wallpaper catalog rather than an AI tool.

apps.title: AI Photo Generator: Remake AI
apps.verdict: An avatar generator with style packs (business, fantasy, editorial, and others). Users on average report that the result does not look like them: wrong skin color, different ethnic appearance, age and body type mismatches. A few successful cases involve LinkedIn portraits for men with European features.
apps.loved: The variety of themed packs attracts people who want to experiment with different looks. A handful of users received results they considered suitable for a professional profile.
apps.weak: The photo does not resemble the person: the app changes ethnic features, hair color, age, and body size without being asked. One user received a photo in club attire on horseback instead of a business shot for a realtor profile. Real facial features are barely detectable in the output.
apps.whoFor: Practically no one with consistent expectations of matching the original.

quotes.text: I am writing to express my disappointment with a recent purchase of an AI photo application advertised on Facebook. Despite the advertising, the results I received for my $34 payment were unsatisfactory and did not meet my expectations. The

apps.title: DaVinci - Image Generator AI
apps.verdict: A general-purpose image generator, not a specialized avatar tool. Prompts are executed inaccurately: character attributes are ignored and random elements are added. Styles exist, but output rarely matches the request. This is a tool for experimental renders, not realistic portraits.
apps.loved: Fast rough renders for storyboarding and concepts. A relatively wide range of styles for text-to-visual experiments.
apps.weak: Images are blurry and incoherent with detailed prompts. Characters change gender, ethnicity, or gain extra items. Iterative editing does not work: a repeated prompt is ignored.
apps.whoFor: Content creators who need rough conceptual sketches, not precise portraits.

apps.title: AI Photo Video Editor, Enhance
apps.verdict: A photo enhancement app that claims to restore old photos and generate AI portraits, but consistently changes facial features beyond recognition: people become different people, color photos receive incorrect color grading. Attempts to restore an old photo of a grandfather succeeded for only a handful of users.
apps.loved: Isolated cases of restoring heavily damaged or very old photos (nearly 100 years old) are described as impressive. The pixel-sharpening feature on pixelated images sometimes works well.
apps.weak: Faces after processing become cartoonish or belong to different people. A sharpei dog photo became a different breed with different coloring. Portrait retouching ignores the person's original appearance.

apps.title: ReShoot: AI Photos & Edits
apps.verdict: An editor with AI processing: retouching, hairstyle changes, age progression, and image cleanup. Handles simple tasks sometimes. Portrait results with a specific person are unstably unlike the original.
apps.loved: Individual users successfully restored old black-and-white family photos and colorized them. Makeup templates on some photos produce a clean and natural result.
apps.weak: After processing, the face often does not resemble the person in the source photo. Strangers appear in the frame and body parts are cut off. Attempts are consumed even on failed generations with no option to retry.
apps.whoFor: May work for restoring old family photos. Not suitable for people who want to try a new hairstyle or get a portrait with recognizable features.

apps.title: PortraitAI - AI Portrait
apps.verdict: Converts photos into the style of historical Renaissance portraits. For light-skinned users the result genuinely looks like an 18th-19th century painting with recognizable features. For everyone else: skin whitening, narrowed nose, changed eye shape and iris color. The app was trained exclusively on Western European portrait painting and cannot handle non-white appearances.
apps.loved: For light-skinned users, facial features are transferred recognizably and the classic portrait painting style is convincing.
apps.weak: Systematically whitens dark skin and changes nose shape, eye shape, and iris color. For most users who are not of Asian or European background, the result is unrecognizable.
apps.whoFor: Only for light-skinned users with European features who are interested in a classical painting style.

quotes.text: I was super excited when I saw this app and how it changed my photos, but then my friend and I realized when we used POC celebrities it white washed them, especially Brown and Black faces, though some Asian faces were also given only Caucas

I used to use the web version, on which they were very clear that the AI is trained on portraits of caucasians so unfortunately doesn't work great on photos of POC (although sometimes I get results that are darker-skinned). It seems like th

apps.title: AI Video Generator - AI Studio
apps.verdict: Generates short videos from text, sometimes with cinematic quality. Results are unpredictable and often do not match the description. The cost per video is prohibitive for a broad audience.
apps.loved: In the best cases the video looks cinematic with natural movement. The result impresses those who have figured out the right prompts.
apps.weak: The final video often ignores prompt details. The content filter triggers on neutral scenes. The generation does not match what was written in the request.
apps.whoFor: Content creators with a budget who are willing to experiment and accept lost credits for the occasional good clip.

apps.title: AI Photo Video Generator: AURA
apps.verdict: An avatar and short video generator that builds a profile from the user's photos. The basic task of producing a portrait resembling the person is handled poorly: several reviewers report the app consistently changes hair color, ethnic appearance, or adds extra limbs. One user described three fingers on a hand and multiple legs at once in a single frame.
apps.loved: Several users received realistic paired portraits during the holiday period. Generation speed is praised as higher than competitors.
apps.weak: Extra legs and three fingers are a recurring defect. The app ignores glasses despite photos showing glasses. The output does not resemble the person, with faces looking glossy and generic. Racial shift is mentioned by several users.
apps.whoFor: People who are comfortable with experimental quality and do not expect portrait accuracy.

quotes.text: I saw the ad for Aura where a woman uploaded a picture of herself and then one of her and her husband, and both photos came out beautifully. So I wanted to try the same. I uploaded two photos of me and my husband, but the generated outfits

apps.title: Aviart: AI Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A multi-feature tool with photo animation, video generation, and a translator, but none of the features work at the promised level. Videos generate in anywhere from 30 minutes to several hours and frequently error out. Animation brings photos to life with unnatural smiles, turning photos into unsettling frames. People in photos look nothing like the originals.
apps.loved: The concept of animating old photos is appealing as an idea. A few users noted the first or second result was acceptable in quality.
apps.weak: Faces in animated clips look unnatural and the smiles are eerie. The app changes facial features beyond recognition, especially when shifting ethnic appearance. Generation can take 4-7 hours with no guarantee of a result.
apps.whoFor: No one until speed and appearance accuracy problems are fixed.

apps.title: YouCam Enhance: AI Photo&Video
apps.verdict: A photo and video enhancement and restoration tool with the right idea but a failed execution: faces distort beyond recognition during processing, strangers appear instead of the originals, and video becomes animation instead of pixel improvement. A 12-dollar headshot delivers one face on 50 backgrounds with no expression variation. Attempts to improve family photos end in monsters.
apps.loved: For non-portrait subjects such as backgrounds, objects, and animals, enhancement sometimes works acceptably.
apps.weak: Faces are systematically distorted or replaced with strangers. Video enhancement adds cartoon animation instead of clarity. Old photo restoration disfigures faces.
apps.whoFor: No one who expects faces to remain recognizable in processed images.

quotes.text: People need to read privacy statements on these apps and I think there wouldn't be as many 4 and 5 star reviews. Overall the app looks terrific and really wanted try it. When starting I went to ai lighting. It opened up my iPhone's permi

apps.title: AI Video - AI Video Generator
apps.verdict: A short video generator from photos. People in results almost never resemble the original: a photo of a dark-skinned husband produced a completely different person in the video. Prompts are ignored, and one user reported a third leg growing out of a foot.
apps.loved: Some users got acceptable results for short dance clips where the focus is not on a specific face. The interface is relatively straightforward.
apps.weak: The face from the uploaded photo is almost never preserved in the final video, and sometimes gender and overall appearance change completely. Movements look unnatural. Use of strangers' faces in promo materials is documented in reviews as a violation.
apps.whoFor: Practically no one who expects likeness to the real person in the photo.

apps.title: AI Photo Generator - Fotorama
apps.verdict: The app generates avatars based on personal photos, but results systematically fall short of expectations: portraits do not resemble the original, with extra arms, blurry faces, and distorted body proportions appearing in the output. Several users noted that quality used to be acceptable but degraded after updates.
apps.loved: Individual users found a good shot among a pack of four, especially in early versions when the algorithm was more stable.
apps.weak: The result does not resemble the person in the photo. Hands and fingers are distorted, extra legs and random strangers appear in shots. Skin looks plastic and head-to-body proportions break. One review: '99% of photos look like a completely different person'.
apps.whoFor: Effectively no one at the current quality level.

apps.title: GIO - AI Photoshoot Generator
apps.verdict: GIO promises AI photo sessions with professional backgrounds and looks. Reality according to reviews: faces are distorted or belong to a different person, the body clearly does not match the user's appearance (a muscular man gets a slender body photo), and backgrounds are blurry. Several independent reviewers directly describe the result as worse than old-fashioned photo compositing. This is one of the weakest quality products in the set.
apps.loved: The idea of themed photo sessions without actual shooting is appealing. Occasionally the first generation is acceptable with a very good source photo in bright lighting.
apps.weak: Faces are distorted or unrecognizable in almost every set. The body in the generation does not match the user's real figure. Quality is significantly below competitors at a comparable price.

apps.title: Revive: AI Face Photo Animator
apps.verdict: Animates photos to music and generates AI avatars. After purchase the app more often performs worse than the demo or does not work. Avatars do not preserve eye color, hair color, or skin tone likeness.
apps.loved: In rare cases the basic photo animation works correctly and is touching, especially for photos of elderly relatives.
apps.weak: AI avatars do not preserve likeness: eye color, hair color, and skin tone do not match. Processing hangs during generation and does not complete for hours. Pet video content barely works.

apps.title: AI Art : Photo Video Generator
apps.verdict: A prompt-based image generator with multiple models. Human anatomy quality is extremely low: three arms, two noses, skeletal heads, and distorted fingers are described by several independent users on the simplest requests. The server is frequently unavailable and generations fail with an error.
apps.loved: Early versions running Stable Diffusion delivered acceptable results for some creative tasks, according to longtime users.
apps.weak: Images with people consistently contain anatomical defects: extra limbs, distorted faces, and prompt mismatches. One user submitted 60 requests and got zero usable results. Prompts are ignored or interpreted arbitrarily.
apps.whoFor: Effectively no one in the current state: output is too unpredictable.

apps.title: Gram AI: Art Creator
apps.verdict: An avatar generator from multiple photos. Faces in the output often belong to different people. Gender is misidentified. Repeat packs may contain the same images already received.
apps.loved: In the best cases, artistic styles such as painting and anime look striking regardless of likeness accuracy.
apps.weak: Faces do not resemble the uploaded photos. Gender is misidentified. Repeat packs contain duplicates of already received images. Removing account access through the app menu is not possible.
apps.whoFor: Hard to recommend: too many complaints about basic non-resemblance and payment issues.

apps.title: GoPhoto:AI Photo & Video Maker
apps.verdict: The app was built around a feature for 'hugging' a deceased loved one, but the execution does not work: faces are not recognized, results do not resemble the uploaded people, gender often flips ('turns women into men'), and hands and fingers are distorted. One user directly wrote that they waited 40 minutes for a video and received nothing.
apps.loved: The idea of interacting with a departed loved one is emotionally significant. When a video does come through, one user called it 'the closest to reality'.
apps.weak: Faces in the output do not resemble the uploaded photos. Hands are distorted and bodies are out of proportion. Generation takes 10 to 40 minutes and frequently ends in an error.
apps.whoFor: Theoretically for people who want to animate archival photos of relatives, but in practice the result is too unreliable.

apps.title: Photic - AI Headshot Generator
apps.verdict: An AI look and filter generator with extremely weak quality. Professional headshots do not resemble the user: the face is placed on a stranger's body and hair is ignored. Filters produce an exaggerated and unflattering result. Many users directly write that the photos made them look worse. Prior modeling experience does not help: the AI does not capture hair, jawline, or features.
apps.loved: Individual users noted acceptable Halloween looks on simple templates with a good source photo.
apps.weak: The result is rarely recognizable as the user. The face is placed on an inappropriate body. Hair and distinctive features are ignored. Effects look unappealing.

apps.title: Boom AI: AI Video Generator
apps.verdict: Generates short videos from photos. Faces in the results almost never preserve likeness to the original person. Several users report their face was replaced by a completely different person.
apps.loved: Some users got acceptable results for short dance clips with no emphasis on a specific face.
apps.weak: Faces do not resemble the uploaded photo, and sometimes gender and overall appearance change completely. Movements look unnatural. Use of strangers' faces in promo materials is documented in reviews as a violation.
apps.whoFor: Hard to recommend to anyone given the current quality and reputation.

apps.title: ImaginAI - AI Art & Video
apps.verdict: Generates content that does not resemble the uploaded photo: a different person, different clothes, and anatomical artifacts (6 arms on a child). From the rare positive reviews, users find the 'visual variety and image quality' appealing, but the character does not match the original. As a tool for creating realistic content with a recognizable face, the app does not work.
apps.loved: A variety of styles and themes, vibrant visual aesthetics in results. When they come out, some people find the images beautiful in their own right.
apps.weak: The face and appearance of the person in the source photo are not transferred to the output. Output videos look staged and unrealistic. Anatomical deformations such as extra limbs appear. No control over style or background.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended for anyone as a face-recognition tool.

apps.title: AI Photo Video Generator: IRMO
apps.verdict: A photo and video face and look generator. Instead of resembling the source, it outputs completely different people and robotic movements. The two-person interaction feature shown in promo materials produces static smiling strangers with no contact.
apps.loved: Frames and background effects without face placement sometimes look acceptable.
apps.weak: Faces are completely replaced with strangers bearing no resemblance to the original. Movements are robotic and unnatural. Two-person scenes from store materials output a static image instead of animated interaction.
apps.whoFor: No one who expects even a loose resemblance to the original photo.

apps.title: Picsify: AI Photo&Video Editor
apps.verdict: Picsify lets you see yourself aged, try on a hairstyle, or get a Ghibli look. According to reviews: the aging result looks unnatural, hairstyles come in wrong colors (orange instead of chestnut, peach instead of silver), the cartoon filter does not preserve likeness to the original face, and dark-skinned users are turned white-skinned.
apps.loved: The idea of seeing yourself at different ages or in different styles generates interest: several users found the concept enjoyable.
apps.weak: Hairstyles in unrealistic colors, aged results with terrible teeth, a cartoon look that does not resemble you, and dark skin whitened beyond recognition. Photos of plants and personal photos are rejected as 'illegal content'.

apps.title: Live Photo: AI Image Generator
apps.verdict: Claims to bring old photos to life, but more often zooms the frame or changes faces beyond recognition. Faces in photos are turned into strangers, and in some cases the racial appearance of characters changed during processing.
apps.loved: Rare successful results on front-facing portrait photos of good quality look lively and convincing.
apps.weak: Faces do not resemble the original or are completely replaced by a different person. Animation often reduces to a head nod or zoom with no real movement. The racial appearance of characters in some photos changed during processing.
apps.whoFor: Only for those willing to spend money on the chance of a rare successful result from a perfect photo.

apps.title: HeyStar-AI Photo Editor
apps.verdict: Generated photos almost never resemble the person in the source image. Several users tried 4-5 different photos in a row with no improvement. Non-white appearances are rendered especially poorly. One of the two positives is that the caricature style appeals to a few users, but even there faces are approximate.
apps.loved: The caricature style of images appeals to some users. The idea of trying on different professions in a portrait is perceived as a fun concept.
apps.weak: The result does not resemble the person in the photo, and this is a systemic problem not an exception. Dark skin is rendered with noticeable distortions. Bodies are out of proportion and hands are enlarged.
apps.whoFor: A fun generator of 'yourself in a different look' with no expectation of portrait accuracy.

apps.title: AI Headshot Photo Generator
apps.verdict: A professional headshot generator from uploaded photos. In the vast majority of cases the result does not resemble the user: cartoonish style, whitening of Asian and dark features, phantom hair on bald people, and distorted fingers.
apps.loved: In isolated cases with an optimal photo set, facial likeness is good enough for use as an avatar in a work profile.
apps.weak: The result almost never resembles the user. Cartoonishness, finger and body distortion, phantom hair on bald people, and whitening of non-white features are consistent problems. There is no way to see the result before paying.
apps.whoFor: No one: quality does not justify a paid subscription according to the overwhelming majority of buyers.
